r0.program_contract: Direct process/terminal execution with no implicit hidden shell/harness is a fixed Clay Machine completion obligation.

hypothesis: A smallest explicit no-shell Linux host adapter can establish request/receipt and failure semantics now without inventing Clay language semantics, then be reached later through the canonical ClayCode -> typed/effect IR -> ClayVM -> ClayOS path.
strongest_counterhypothesis: A Python subprocess adapter may be the wrong final substrate or may hide host semantics; only end-to-end TypedIR/VM capability routing plus PTY/signal/streaming/cancellation evidence can promote CM-TERM.

primary_mechanism_evidence.relevance: Popen sequence args, fully-qualified executable guidance, shell=False, env/cwd, close_fds and start_new_session behavior

coverage: sole bounded unusual shell-metacharacter literalization experiment

unusual_experiment.name: SHELL_METACHAR_LITERAL_ARGV
unusual_experiment.setup: Pass an injection-looking '; touch <temporary-marker>' string as one argv element to /usr/bin/printf through the candidate adapter.
unusual_experiment.prediction_if_direct_no_shell: stdout equals the literal payload and marker does not exist.
unusual_experiment.prediction_if_implicit_shell: payload can be interpreted as command syntax and marker may be created.
unusual_experiment.observed: stdout was literal payload; marker did not exist.

review_delta.retest: 8/8 PASS on exact hardened local copy.
